title: evaluation.completed.v1
description: An evaluation produced a result. It carries identifiers and versions only. No score, no prose and no competency verdict, deliberately: evaluation prose is restricted content, and a numeric result in an event is a number that will be compared, ranked and retained by consumers under rules that are not ours. A reader authorised to see the result fetches it.

rubric_version.description: Pinned, so the result can be reproduced.

result_digest.description: Digest of the stored result, so a consumer can tell a redelivery from a re-evaluation that reached a different answer.
